The '''Gladiators' Open''' was a open-ended gladiatorial challenge that was held on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]].

==Overview==
A combatant was matched up with an opponent that was theoretically equal in ability, but it was not uncommon for a round to have participants of widely different skill levels. The Open had up to a dozen gladiators who were forced to fight until only one remained. The combat arenas varied, including urban areas, jungle environments, and the [[Zero-Gee Hall]]. Weapons ranged from [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-axes]] to beam pistols.<ref name="ND" />

A victorious combatant could retire after one round and receive a prize of 5000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The prize amount doubled for every successive round.<ref name="ND" />
